narrationScript: Welcome to Chapter 3.2: Sorting Algorithms. In this module, we'll dive into one of the most fundamental problems in computer science: how to efficiently arrange data in a specific order. You'll learn the core principles behind three classic algorithms: Bubble Sort, Selection Sort, and Insertion Sort. We'll explore their step-by-step processes, implement them in C, and crucially, analyze their performance using Big O notation. By the end, you'll understand why sorting is so important for tasks like searching and data management, and you'll be able to compare the practical efficiency of these foundational techniques.
speakingStyle: A clear, confident, and enthusiastic tone, suitable for technical instruction.
deliveryNotes: Stress the importance of Big O analysis
